'''Shana Turi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Garos IV]]. She was a member of the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|Garos resistance]] and a friend of [[Alexandra Winger]]. Living in the city of [[Zila]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], she discovered that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was storing components for a [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|V-150 anti-orbital ion cannon]] in the neighboring base. The resistance later assaulted the base and destroyed it.<ref name="Mission to Zila" />
